nom: OSEA Ocean Eyes Age-Defying Eye Serum

avis.texte: It seems to have made my bags under my eyes larger and puffier by rolling it on. Not a fan.
This product a greatly reduced the bags under my eyes after 3 weeks. I will continue using it.

avis.titre: Like a Drink for my eyes!!
avis.texte: Love the liquid feel around my eyes and how well it absorbs into the skin!
Only been using for a couple of weeks. My eyes don't look as tired as before.

avis.titre: Feels great when you roll it on
avis.texte: It feels great rolling it under my eyes and around. I'm just not sure the puffiness goes away.
I've been using this serum for 4+ years twice a day. It works and I cannot go without it. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Nice Cooling Tip That's About It !
avis.texte: Maybe, I used too much but I don't see any results. My bags are still under my eyes, plus I developed a severe allergic reaction.

Wow! So many good reviews. I really wanted to like this serum. It has a watery consistency, although the cooling effect from metal tip feels nice under the eyes The company must have sold me an expired product or something, absolutely doesn't work at all after 2 months of usage. I'm thinking of giving this to a friend of mine...At this price point I expected a miracle under eye balm.
This eye serum really does reduce puffiness, dark circles & fine lines! I love the cooling rollerball applicator too!
This stuff is amazing! Its a new part of my morning ritual. The metal roller ball stays cool for refreshing application.

Received this item last week and am very disappointed with it. First of all, it irritated my eyes the first time I used it. It isnt irritating anymore, but now it does absolutely nothing! Not worth my money at all.
I have just started the use for my older puffy eyes but already see a difference. It is cool and hydrating. I put mine in the frigerator to make it cold and helps even more of the puffiness.
A luxurious-feeling serum, under eye skin is smoother and cc softer. Ill buy more when I use up the sample!
I have loved every product of Osea but this one. I apply it and my eyes instantly turn purple underneath. It hasn't been the result I expected.
Great under eye treatment, love the results Makes the under eye soft and soothed

I am ridiculously allergic to most eye serums. And this one is perfection! I just gifted my good friend who was visiting from Montpelier, france, and she loves it too! I am on a few bottles deep and I like what I see in the mirror! Also woman owned no animal testing or products. It's just a win all around.

avis.titre: i does not do anything for me
avis.texte: Unfortunately, this product did not work for me. After applying it, my eyes felt dry, and I did not notice any improvement. I am 56 years old, so this product may be more suitable for younger users.

I tend to use the product after my workouts and getting ready for the day. The cooling rollerball along with the texture of the product is so calming to the sensitive eye area. I have very reactive eczema and the OSEA products have not caused any inflammations or reactions to my skin. What a wonderful line of skincare!

avis.titre: Expected it to be a serum
avis.texte: The product is like water. I expected it to be more like a serum. I want to like it but it does seem to do anything.
Love this eye serum! Feels so cooling and moisturizing around the eyes! I also roll it around my lips!
I have used this for a couple of years and love it. It feels great whether you are just waking up or after a long day. So soothing and lessens puffiness. Great product.
Ive integrated this into both my morning and evening routines, and wow! My under eye circles have started to fade and the skin stays hydrated.
Love how this glides on, using it twice daily seems to be helping with fine lines. Ill give a follow up review once I use the rest of the serium.
It rolls on easily. I use it every morning after waking up and washing my face. I love this serum It refreshes my eye area and feels great!

avis.titre: Good product, Faulty packaging made it leak out while travel
avis.texte: Love the product but both bottles Ive had leaked a good portion out when I traveled with it, its expensive so I feel like I wasted a lot of money since a lot leaked out.

Love this! I use it every day morning and night, it is so cooling on the skin from the metal roller ball. And it helps with my dark circles too. And it also lasts forever. I've been using it for about six weeks. And it's only about a 1/4 gone.

I can see a difference in the dark circles under my eyes and I feel like I dont have to use as much concealer to try and cover that area up. I love the roller ball applicator for easy application, but especially for the soothing coolness I feel after removing eye makeup. Extra rubbing and wiping around the eyes to remove makeup causes my eye area to feel irritated and tight and it feels so good to swipe this serum under my eyes after I use the Ocean Cleanser!! Soothing relief for tired eyes too.

Came across this product when I purchased the body lotion and oil set gift (rder S-2147591) for a friend. I was so excited that Ive placed both serum and eye cream in my Christmas list. I was so excited after receiving it from my sister. Its been weeks and my eyes look more tired than ever and Im just in my 40s. Puffier, darker, my left eye bag now sags more so my eyes are uneven. Its not a fit. Need to return.

This is the first time I've ever used an eye serum. It smells great and is easy to use. Has a cool-to-the touch roller ball applicator. Haven't noticed a physical difference but I use it ever night and it makes me feel great nonetheless. I love Osea products.

I use this eye serum every day to help with morning puffiness. I have sensitive skin and have had no adverse reactions. Your products made from ingredients from the sea are a godsend to those of us with reactive skin. Thank you!
Reduces puffiness, dark circles and fine lines and very refreshing to use in the morning. Love it.
Nothing good but nothing bad either. Maybe i just didnt have any big lines for this to fix? I felt no tightening. I do like the application.
I want to love it but it didn't do anything to my under eyes.
This product did absolutely nothing for me. Its watery and doesnt seem to have any feel to it. I returned it.

It's cooling and soothing - a quick refresh each morning and evening and I am good to go. Can't say for sure that this reduces bags and puffiness, but i havebeen using this for a while and that old puffiness is no longer a worry - something is working! More important it feels good - that enough helps.

44 yo former smoker and tanning bed enthusiast. By my age you pretty much have the skin you deserve. This product COMPLETELY ERASED the crow's feet around my eyes and there's no more puffiness. I use it constantly and 1 lasts a long time.
I love, love this! I have tried numerous eye creams. This is the first one that I have actually seen amazing ling term results. Im now gifting it as one of my favorite things!
Love this product. Love that its a rollerball. Love the coolness and the smooth application!
I Love ❤️ It !!!! It's A Clean Feeling & Soft & Smooth..Leaves Your Skin Feeling Nice Has A Nice Fresh Scent Too. !!!! Thank You...

I truly truly love all of my OSEA products. They are keeping my skin moist and dewey. I am constantly getting compliments on my skin from young and old alike. And my skin really does not feel the aging that it should at this point in my life, Im 66 and my skin is so soft and so moist. I just love, love, love all of your products thank you very very very much.

I had high hopes but this did not for my under eyes. The only pro is that it felt refreshing, but I saw zero results. My under eyes continue to be puffy with dark circles. Also, the roller fell out after 3/4 of it's use.
The eye serum is amazing! Im getting ready to order the body oil next which I cant wait try.

I've used this for a few weeks now, and the only redeeming quality this has (for the steep price) is the cooling rollerball. I do not find this achieves any of the advertised benefits. It does not depuff, reduce dark circles and fine lines, and it certainly is not moisturizing. The formula is watery and not emollient, so once it dries it evaporates away and leaves no moisture or slip on my skin. Will not repurchase.
Use it every night! I feel like my skin is much better now with all the Osea products.

avis.titre: Beware. Caused serious skin irritation. Do not buy.
avis.texte: Within moments of putting this item on my undereyes, my skin turned red and started burning. It was so fast and severe, I had to wash it off immediately. I do not recommend this product.

I love the way my undereyes feel and look when I use this product. Its the first time I ever felt like an undereye serum really worked for me. After 1-2 weeks of using it day and night I could really see a difference, and so could others!

This eye serum is the absolute best. Not only does it relieve your eyes, it definitely helps with fine lines, puffiness and dark circles. Noticed a difference right away and have added the item to my subscription list! You cant miss this!!

I only gave it 3 stars because i have not used it long enough to see sby difference. What i love is how the rollerball glides around my orbital structure. I keep it in the refridgerator so when i use it its very cool and refreshing helping to depuff. I hope it works as good for me as it does for all the other reviews that gave it 5 stars!!
I am so pleased that this product has helped to reduce the fine lines around my eyes. I am so happy!!
This is the most luxurious eye serum Ive ever used and it actually makes a visible difference from the first use. Id recommend this product to anyone!
I am really loving this product. It feels great going on, and feels very nourishing. I will buy this product again.
It took me a while to warm up to this eye cream. I thought the watery texture would do nothing for my eyes however they do appear brighter after a few weeks.
The serum barely comes out when I roll it - wanted to love...

Im a regular Biologique Recherche user, always searching for good quality, natural and simple to use skincare line, which I can incorporate along my BR. OSEA hits the spot, including the body line. As for this eye serum, I was at first a bit skeptical since I have very dry skin (head to toes; mature, 48 yrs; not particularly sensitive). But over time I began addicted (and used to the water down formula). I go as far as rolling it over my lips before applying lip balm. As we just moved to a new house and most of my precious skincare is still packed, so is this night serum (I dont know what I thinking when I was packingtime crunch I guess). Now, it will take a while to get through all the boxes to find my miracle UNI!
It really helps with hydration and reduces under eye puffiness
This does feel nice going on but ive seen no results. I think the undereye is hard to treat. I love OSEA products and will continue to buy but not this one.
This stuff literally feels like a scam when you apply it. It does not do anything.

avis.titre: Product not full & customer service would not help!
avis.texte: I've been slowly switching all my body care and skin care to this company. When I opened the box after purchasing in store in a different town I live in, the product was only 3/4 full, I reached out to customer service and they would NOT help me.

avis.titre: Love this - so easy to apply
avis.texte: This is a wonderful product - so easy to apply. Feels cooling and light and I really think my under eye skin looks amazing. I prefer this to the other eye cream by Osea. I just like the lighter formula and the applicator makes a big difference - not a fan of dipping my fingers into the jar of the heavier formula.

Many eye creams sting and this one does not. Its so lightweight that sometimes I feel like Im using a lot to just get it to cover. Im going through it quicker than Id like. I do noticed a big difference in my under eye bags but the darkness seems to be unchanged.
Hands down the best skin care for mature skin, skin feels great as well as looking younger by the day
LOVE THIS PRODUCT, I KEEP IT IN MY FRIDGE HELPS MY EYES FEEL COOL, LESS PUFFY, AND MORE AWAKE.

avis.titre: a little goes a long way -- glorious product
avis.texte: this is so refreshing -- and lasts forever. brightens and soothes. use it all day long!
I was so excited to order after reading the reviews, but this did nothing for me. AT ALL. So sad
This is my go to. I share my love for this product with all of my friends and cannot recommend it enough.
I love that I was able to travel with this. Easy on the eyes, but you can feel the magic of it.

I mean I don't see any improvement what so ever not sure it's doing anything to be honest. I use it twice a day I put it on under my eyes on a fresh cleansed face then after it drys I put the rest of my face routine on. But like I said if I'm being honest I see no change with my under eyes what so ever.
This serum brightens my eyes so well. Definitely will be repurchasing
I bought this to use in the morning to address the morning bags under my eyes. It doesnt seem to make any difference in my opinion. Very watery

avis.titre: Not seeing change after a couple of weeks
avis.texte: Not seeing a change in about 2 weeks. Will continue of course. May be better later.

I love OSEA products. This is the first product I've used where I did not see visible results. (I used the entire bottle.) Good news is it did not irritate my eyes or skin, but unfortunately, I did not see any results at all!

I use this on my under eyes after each cleansing morning and night. It cools and soothes, reduces puffiness, and I can see a difference in the darkness that was there does not irritate highly recommend.

I started using the Age-Defying Eye Serum about 8 months ago when I also started to lose weight. I'm amazed that, despite a significant amount of face changes, my under eye skin and smile lines are looking really good!! I attribute it to a pretty consistent day/night Osea skin care routine (and water and sunscreen!) and am so glad I found this company!! Pic without makeup after a Hot Yoga class, so I'm not usually that pink, but wanted to show my smile lines.
I use it am & pm but i don't see any difference under eyes. I keep it in my mini fridge so it has a cool feeling but other than that is like water. I wont buy it again.

While it felt nice when applying, there were no visible changes noticed after using for weeks. Also, when I went to open the bottle the entire top broke off glass and shattered. So thankful that I did not get injured.

I look forward to applying this so much. That soothing, cool feeling is one of the reasons I never forget to use it. Ive only been using it for a few weeks, but can already see a real difference. My circles are lighter and fine lines are finer. I am 63-years old with very dry skin.
I am a nurse that suffers from bags under my eyes & I use this morning and night. This serum has changed my life, it hydrates my skin sooo well !
I've been using this eye serum for 4 months & have not noticed a single difference under my eyes. Very disappointed.

I got this product in a subscription box. I like how refreshing the roller ball feels, but I'm not sure I'm seeing results after 3 months of use. It's nice but I wouldn't justify reordering at full price.
LOVE this brand but this product irritated my under eye turning the area dry and red. I see others had similar experiences too. There are much better eye products out there.
I love the cool feeling when rolling the serum around my eyes. Not heavy or greasy

I wouldn't suggest this product for anyone with sensitive skin. Since it's vegan, I thought it'd be okay. I keep getting a red rash on my top eyelid. Almost looks like the eczema I get on the bends of my arms. It's irritated and a little painful. I do not see a difference in my fine lines and wrinkles either. I dont think its worth the buy.
This serum does what it says it does. My eyes look much more awake, less puffy and fine lines are significantly less defined. I will repurchase.
Ive used this product for about a year and can see that it is effective, which frankly is unusual in skin products

I wanted to love this so much but unfortunately I developed the worst rash under my eyes. We're talking very painful, blistering, inflamed rash. I loved the roller ball and the cooling effect it had but I had to return it.
I have only been using the product for two weeks but have already noticed that my eyes aren't nearly as puffy anymore. I love to use this in the morning the cooling effect feels amazing.

I really wanted to get an eye cream, but the one I was looking at was out of stock so I thought I would just try this and was kind of hoping it would be OK It is amazing and I love it and Im not sure Ill go try the cream after this! Its easy to apply and soothing and feels great and looks great!!! Highly recommend!!

Not only does this feel amazing, but after a couple weeks of use, both my teenage daughters asked me on sperate occasions why my under eyes looked so "glowy!" I really didn't think it was doing much, but the fact that they noticed made me look again and compare some pictures and this really has done some amazing work around my eyes. The price is a little steep, but I may buy it again because it works and feels great.

I've read a lot of reviews on this so I was skeptical, but I purchased this and put it on, a little bit later I looked in the mirror and was actually shocked at the difference it made. I have a tiny bit of crows feet, dark circles and a little bit of hollowness. Hollowness completely gone, half of the crows feet and dark circles are gone! From one use. I am SHOCKED! Definitely recommend! No issues with the roller or bottle etc. Has a very very super light smell of maybe oranges? I'm not sure, it's almost untraceable. Feels light and soaked in quickly. I don't write reviews often, unless I absolutely love or hate an item. I'm 33
Ocean Eyes is a must have as part of my morning skin care routine! Works wonders under my eyes.
Ocean eyes doesnt moisturize or feel like anything at all. It feels nice and cool with the roller but that it. It feels like water

Ive been using this for about a month and i just dont feel like its really doing anything. Half the time when i use it, it really irritates and burns my eyes which is weird because its a vegan formula. Overall for the price its not worth it in my opinion.

This product contains Sodium Benzoate: A preservative generally regarded as safe when consumed in amounts less than 5 mg/kg of body weight per day. However, it can form benzene, a known carcinogen, when combined with ascorbic acid (vitamin C) under certain conditions. It also contains Potassium Sorbate: Another preservative with low cancer concerns but moderate potential for allergies and immunotoxicity

avis.titre: Best eye product for recovering chapped damaged eyes after t
avis.texte: After that horrible Santa Ana that devastated Los Angeles, my eyes were red chapped puffy bubbly drysore mess. Nothing could give me relief and more often aggravated and burned the skin until I tried Ocean Eyes Age-Defying Eye Serum. Osea thank you for making this and I will use it forever.

helped get rid of this stubborn milia that ive had since last year in a matter of days. but to be fair this the only eye cream ive tried in years so idk if any other eye cream woulve got rid of it too in days. and my creases do seem a little noticeable so 10/10 in my eyes :)
This product is amazing! The roller ball feels so cool on the skin and helps with de-puffing of the eyes. Love this product, it has become my favorite next to the essential hydrating oil.

I normally never use eye serums only eye creams. Decided to try and i am in love!!! Now i wont stop using it, its a must in my skin care routine. I love the way it "glides" into my skin, i love the way it feels and looks - no stickiness, no residue, no oily feeling... Then I put the eye cream on top! Highly recommended the DUO!!!
Obsessed! I put it on throughout the day every day, feels so refreshing, awakes my eyes

I absolutely love every single OSEA product. I am a single mother, first grade teacher ~ and always on the go! The products help me to feel as if I am staying healthy while doing so. My only request would be the consideration of a teacher discount, as the products are a real splurge at this point :) Many thanks! Mary Montes
